title: run_local_subagent arguments
description: Hand one well-specified coding task to a local model. It works in its own git worktree and branch; the router then runs your check commands there, retries with their output, and returns a short record (passed, failed or escalate). The branch is untrusted output from a smaller model: read `git diff <base_commit>..<branch>` before you merge it. Best for bounded, verifiable, mostly single-file work.

task.description: What to change and why, as a self-contained spec: the model sees only this, the listed files and what it reads itself.

files.description: Paths or globs, relative to the repo root, that the worker may create or change. Any other change escalates.

commands.description: Shell commands run from the worktree root after the worker stops. The job passes only if every one exits 0.

must_not_touch.description: Paths or globs the worker must never change; one change escalates at once. Default: the test files tracked at base that are not in `files`.

repo.description: Absolute path of the git repo. Default: the server's working directory.

base.description: Git ref the worktree starts from. Default HEAD, so commit what the task needs first: uncommitted changes are not in the worktree.

max_retries.description: Extra attempts after failing checks, each starting from the failing output.

wait.description: true blocks until the record is ready; false returns a job_id at once, to poll with job_status or wait_jobs.

relpath.description: Relative path or glob, never absolute, never through '..'.
